recommendations.name: JITLine
recommendations.description: Research code that predicts defect-introducing commits and ranks the risky lines within them, reported as faster and more accurate than the deep-learning alternatives, but it ships as notebooks with no stated license, so it is a starting point rather than a drop-in tool.

recommendations.name: SZZ Unleashed
recommendations.description: MIT-licensed implementation of the SZZ algorithm that finds bug-introducing commits from git history, with example scripts that extract commit features and train a random forest for just-in-time bug prediction.

recommendations.name: CC2Vec
recommendations.description: Deep-learning code-change representations (used together with DeepJIT) for just-in-time defect prediction on commits, but it is old (Python 3.6, torch 1.2) with no stated license and a study found it does not consistently beat simpler models.
